title: Saturn Super Vol. 1
native_title: サターン・スーパー Ｖｏｌ．１
overview: The demo disc released with the first volume of Saturn Super magazine, published by Captain Soft. It includes playable demos of Wing Arms, in a very early form, and Race Drivin', along with video previews of other Saturn titles such as Riglord Saga, Clockwork Knight and X-Men: Children of the Atom.
